text:
Noah P.: Hello team, I'm Noah onboarding to on-call next week. Two quick blockers: I don't have call escalation enabled in PagerDuty, and I can't find the mock incident runner.
Rina M.: Welcome Noah! For call escalation you need "pager-call-access" in Okta. @samir can approve. Also add mobile under Profile -> Contact Methods in PD.
Noah P.: I tried adding mobile but PD rejects it with 'unverified' error.
Infra Bot: auto: Verification error common. Ensure phone is in HR profile or verify via 2FA. If blocked, file Okta request: https://okta.example.com/app/requests/new tag "oncall-call".
Samir K.: I'll approve any call-access requests. Ping me once you submit and I'll fast-track.
Noah P.: Thanks. About mock incidents  where are they and how do I run a 30-minute drill?
Rina M.: Repo: infra/playbooks/mock-incidents. Runner: `python3 tools/mock_incident_runner.py --scenario auth-failure --duration 30` You need repo access and aws sts perms for staging.
Noah P.: I don't have repo access yet, and my aws-role isn't in the oncall-staging group.
Infra Bot: auto: Grant checklist: 1) Git access via Okta 2) Add AWS role 'oncall-staging' via IAM request 3) Confluence read access to eng-oncall runbooks. Links: https://git.example.com/access-requests, https://iam.redwood/request, https://confluence.redwood/infer/eng-oncall
Noah P.: Any recommended runbooks to skim before the drill?
Rina M.: Read: "Incident Triage", "Auth Failure Playbook", "Escalation Matrix (L1->L2)". Also do the async module "Oncall Basics".
Noah P.: How do we mark a shift as 'mentor-assisted' so alerts route to both mentor and me?
Samir K.: We tag schedule entries in PagerDuty with override: add secondary -> mentor. Use the 'add on-call pairing' checkbox in the schedule UI. If you need help, DM me and I'll set it.
Noah P.: Cool. Last: if I need to swap with someone in CET, what's the etiquette?
Rina M.: Use PD override and post a swap message in #eng-oncall with the shift link. For swaps crossing daylight saving time, mention UTC times explicitly.
Noah P.: Got it. I'll submit Okta forms now and book a 30m pre-drill with Rina. Thanks all!
Oncall Bot: Reminder: Complete "Oncall Basics" async module before your first shadow. Live drill scheduled Sun 17:00 UTC with Rina M..
thread_summary: Noah onboarding: phone call escalation, mock incident runner access, schedules and mentor-assisted shifts
